name: returning_customer_registers_as_new_reused
use_case: New and returning customers and their preferences
branch: A returning customer believes she is new and asks to register; create_customer is refused because the email exists on file, so the agent looks up and reuses her profile
tests: the agent attempts registration, handles the email conflict refusal, and looks up the existing customer profile
instruction:
You think you are a first-time customer and ask to register an account with Northlight Studios. Provide your details (name Ana Morales, email ana.morales@example.com, phone +1 212 555 0101).

Your details:
- Name: Ana Morales
- Email: ana.morales@example.com
- Phone: +1 212 555 0101

persona.name: Ana S. Morales
persona.initial_message: Hi! I think this is my first time booking with Northlight Studios. Can you register me? My name is Ana Morales, email is ana.morales@example.com, and phone is +1 212 555 0101.
